description: Image URLs (own CDN, no attribution burden) for a vehicle variant. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. Full catalogue: pay per request with x402, no key (GET /v1/variants/{id}/specs $0.05, /v1/search $0.005, /v1/variants $0.005, /v1/compare $0.1, USDC on Base); the Apify Actor, billed per event by Apify (https://apify.com/carsdatacom/car-specs-api); or the whole database as a licensed export (https://cars-data.com/en/api).

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id from search_cars or filter_cars, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d

name: get_images

data.description: Images of the variant; empty when it has none

url.description: Image URL on the cars-data.com CDN

variant.description: hero = large lead image, card = thumbnail-size

title: Get variant images
